original_question: Kalinda anashughulikia fumbo la vipande 360 pamoja na mamake. Kawaida Kalinda anaweza kuongeza vipande 4 kwa dakika. Mamake kimsingi anaweza kuweza nusu ya vipande ambavyo Kalinda anaweza kuweka kwa dakika. Itawachukua saa ngapi kukamilisha fumbo hilo?
question_template: {name_female, Kalinda} anafanya fumbo lenye vipande {num_digit_1, 360} na mama yake. {name_female, Kalinda} anaweza kuweka vipande {num_digit_2, 4} kwa dakika. Mama yake kwa kawaida huweka {num_frac_1, nusu} ya idadi hiyo ya vipande kwa dakika. Itawachukua saa ngapi kumaliza fumbo hili?
question_solution: answer = num_digit_1 / ((num_digit_2 + f1 * num_digit_2) * 60)   # f1 is the numeric value of num_frac_1
